newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Shell's Argentine unit to invest $1 bln by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Shell's Argentine unit to invest $1 bln by 2000.

text.p: Shell CAPSA, the Argentine subsidiary of Royal Dutch/Shell Group, plans to invest $1.0 billion by 2000 in exploration, production refinery and marketing operations in Argentina, the company's president told a newspaper Tuesday.

"During 1996 we will have invested about $200 million. At the same time, by 2000 we foresee investing more than $1.0 billion, of which $600 million will go to our Buenos Aires refinery," Jorge Brea wrote in an El Cronista supplement.
But Brea said Shell CAPSA's refining margins have been hit by higher oil prices: "In this context, the company's 1996 results will be good but with lower profits than last year."
